headline: Suspension Of Legislative Member Due To Scandal Involvement
content: The parliamentary group of government party suspended yesterday its member José Urquiho due to his connection with former operator Montesinos, Scar López Ménesses. This decision was taken after it became known that Urquiho had admitted knowing both López Ménesses and his brother-in-law, Colonel Osvaldo Zapata.
